name: Lyra
author: Project Lyra
description: The Lyra platform: the mod manager UI, zuxhook, nativeapp daemon, and its component mods (mods-tab, wifi-power, clock-date) all wrapped in a pretty bow.
changelog: A setting changed anywhere other than the quick menu now survives a restart. Mods reach the platform through a published SDK instead of compiling its internals, so a platform update can no longer break one silently.
